```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

interactmeta ships the tables below as package data (`data()`). Use this page as
a catalog; object documentation is on the [Reference](../reference/index.html)
index under **Data**.

- **Software walk-through:** [Getting started with CAMS](cams.html) (`age`,
  then `steroids`).
- **Construction comparison:** [DA, AD, and SWADA vs CAMS](comparing-da-ad-swada.html).

## At a glance

| Dataset | Setting | Subgroups | Effect on `yi` | Used in |
|---------|---------|-----------|----------------|---------|
| [`steroids`](../reference/steroids.html) | COVID-19 corticosteroids | IMV, Non-IMV | Log OR from counts | [cams](cams.html), [comparing](comparing-da-ad-swada.html) |
| [`il6`](../reference/il6.html) | IL-6 antagonists, COVID-19 | Steroids yes / no | Log OR from counts | [cams](cams.html) |
| [`age`](../reference/age.html) | MS immunotherapies | Younger, Older | Log IRR | [cams](cams.html) |
| [`edss`](../reference/edss.html) | Same MS review | Lower / Higher EDSS | Log IRR | --- |
| [`respire_age`](../reference/respire_age.html) | RESPIRE bronchiectasis | `<65`, `>=65` | Log HR | [comparing](comparing-da-ad-swada.html) |
| [`respire_sex`](../reference/respire_sex.html) | Same RESPIRE trials | Female, Male | Log HR | --- |

> **Incomplete subgroups.** Some COVID tables list only one stratum per trial
> (`n = 0` means no patients in the other subgroup, not “zero events”). Drop
> empty rows before `escalc()`; `ifrac()` can append a high-variance placeholder
> for mixed tables (`?ifrac`, [cams](cams.html)).

## `steroids`

WHO REACT prospective meta-analysis of systemic corticosteroids in critically
ill COVID-19 patients [@stern2020react]. Ventilation modifiers: IMV and Non-IMV.

```{r steroids, echo = c(1, 2)}
data(steroids, package = "interactmeta")
knitr::kable(
  head(steroids, 6),
  caption = "First six rows of `steroids`."
)
```

## `il6`

Hospitalised COVID-19 mortality by concomitant corticosteroids (yes / no)
[@stern2021il6].

```{r il6, echo = c(1, 2)}
data(il6, package = "interactmeta")
knitr::kable(head(il6, 6), caption = "First six rows of `il6`.")
```

## `age`

Systematic review of relapsing–remitting MS immunotherapies [@heesen2024]
(primary example in [cams](cams.html) and [@panaro2025cams]). Relapse rate on
the log incidence-rate ratio scale; published values are in `yi` with
$\sigma^2$ in `vi`. CONFIRM arms appear as `CONFIRM-B` and `CONFIRM-C`. Age
cut-offs per trial are not stored in the object.

```{r age, echo = c(1, 2)}
data(age, package = "interactmeta")
knitr::kable(head(age, 6), caption = "First six rows of `age`.")
```

## `edss`

Same review and endpoint as `age`, with Lower vs Higher EDSS strata. Thresholds
are in the primary publications, not in this table.

```{r edss, echo = c(1, 2)}
data(edss, package = "interactmeta")
knitr::kable(head(edss, 6), caption = "First six rows of `edss`.")
```

## `respire_age`

RESPIRE 1 and 2: time to exacerbation in bronchiectasis [@desoyza2018respire1].
Age strata `<65` vs `>=65`; complete two-row-per-trial layout. Log HRs and
$\sigma^2$ (`vi`) are precomputed from published intervals (respect each
trial's `ci_level`). Complete-table illustration in
[@panaro2026subgroup] and [comparing-da-ad-swada](comparing-da-ad-swada.html).

```{r respire_age, echo = c(1, 2)}
data(respire_age, package = "interactmeta")
knitr::kable(head(respire_age, 6), caption = "First six rows of `respire_age`.")
```

## `respire_sex`

Same trials with Female vs Male strata [@aksamit2018respire2].

```{r respire_sex, echo = c(1, 2)}
data(respire_sex, package = "interactmeta")
knitr::kable(head(respire_sex, 6), caption = "First six rows of `respire_sex`.")
```
